info.name: NC Tower
info.summary: Nextcloud orchestrator for admin, stacks, host health, and ops inbox
info.description:
**NC Tower** is a Nextcloud admin orchestrator — users, apps, system info, and an optional host sidecar for Docker/day-ops.
Fork of [Admin Cockpit](https://github.com/zomtec2311/admincockpit) by Wolfgang Tödt (AGPL-3.0), rebranded and extended.
### Features - Unified admin pages (users, apps, system) via public Nextcloud APIs - Optional allowlisted host sidecar for container/stack health and ops inbox - Configurable deep links (Portainer, Webmin, monitoring UIs, …) — empty by default - Webmin / Portainer remain break-glass when you configure their URLs
### Privacy / sidecar The Nextcloud app itself does not require the sidecar. The sidecar is an **optional privileged host agent** (Docker socket + allowlisted host tools). Administrators configure its URL and token; stock defaults use Docker DNS (`http://nc_tower_sidecar:18765`) and do not embed lab IPs. See [docs/PRIVACY.md](https://github.com/vdroners/nc-tower/blob/main/docs/PRIVACY.md).
See CREDITS.md for attribution.
